pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Pixel gradients at the edges are moderately soft. Patch size is heterogeneous, with smaller, more fragmented shapes located towards the peripheral edges and larger, more cohesive regions in the central flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily connect three to four pathways. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform throughout the visible central region, maintaining high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge, created by individual hair-groupings against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, localized area of de-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the lower-left portion of the torso, appearing as a desaturated, greyish patch that interrupts the standard pelage pattern.
